name: Cua đá Cù Lao Chàm
summary: Cua đá is the land crab, off the daily table, and taken for visitors only from 1 March to 31 July. Boiled, the meat is sweet, fragrant, and firm, and not fishy.
origin: Cham Islands. A forest crab on Tân Hiệp, regulated inside the nature reserve.
taste: The boiled meat is not fishy, and it is sweet, fragrant, and firm.
howToEat: The crab is grilled, or boiled and eaten with salt and pepper. Take only crab with an eco-label, caught in the allowed season.

Quyết định 63/2026/QĐ-UBND, Article 13, sets the carapace at 7 cm or wider, the season from 1 March to 31 July, and the ground as the intertidal rock of the service-administration zone. The strict zone and the restoration zone are closed to the catch.
where: Tân Hiệp, inside the season. Out of season, leave it.
seoTitle: Cua đá Cù Lao Chàm — stone crab in season
seoDescription: Stone crab on Tân Hiệp is a visitor catch from 1 March to 31 July, carapace 7 cm or wider. Boiled, the meat is sweet, fragrant, and firm.
